jsonld.name: LindaMar Cleaning Services LLC
jsonld.description: Residential house cleaning company in Jacksonville, FL offering deep cleaning, recurring weekly and bi-weekly cleaning, move in/out cleaning and kitchen and bathroom detailing.

parrafo.es: LindaMar Cleaning Services limpia casas en Jacksonville con visitas únicas de limpieza profunda y planes recurrentes semanales o quincenales. El equipo llega puntual, trae sus propios productos y deja cocinas, baños y pisos impecables.
parrafo.en: LindaMar Cleaning Services cleans homes across Jacksonville with one-time deep cleans and recurring weekly or bi-weekly plans. The team shows up on time, brings their own supplies, and leaves kitchens, bathrooms and floors spotless.

hero.imagen_alt: LindaMar Cleaning Services team member mopping hardwood floors in a bright open-plan kitchen and dining room in a Jacksonville home

parrafo_1.es: LindaMar Cleaning Services es una empresa de limpieza residencial en Jacksonville, FL. El equipo de Linda hace limpieza profunda, limpieza recurrente semanal y quincenal, limpieza de mudanza y detalle de cocinas y baños, siempre con sus propios productos.
parrafo_1.en: LindaMar Cleaning Services is a residential cleaning company based in Jacksonville, FL. Linda's team handles deep cleaning, recurring weekly and bi-weekly cleaning, move in/out cleaning and kitchen and bathroom detailing, always bringing their own supplies.

parrafo_2.es: Reseña tras reseña en Google, los clientes mencionan a Linda y su equipo por nombre: puntuales, minuciosos y de precios razonables. Una clienta lleva más de 2 años trabajando con ellas. 23 reseñas y una calificación de 4.8 lo respaldan.
parrafo_2.en: Review after review on Google, customers name Linda and her team directly: punctual, thorough and reasonably priced. One client has worked with them for more than 2 years. 23 reviews and a 4.8 rating back that up.

texto.es: Nos cuentas el tamaño de tu casa y qué necesitas: una limpieza profunda, un plan recurrente o una limpieza de mudanza.
texto.en: Tell us the size of your home and what you need: a deep clean, a recurring plan, or a move in/out cleaning.

texto.es: Te damos un precio claro según el tamaño de la casa y la frecuencia que elijas, sin sorpresas.
texto.en: We give you a straightforward price based on the size of your home and the frequency you choose, no surprises.

texto.es: Cocinas, baños y pisos, detallados por el mismo equipo de confianza, con sus propios productos.
texto.en: Kitchens, bathrooms and floors, detailed by the same trusted team, with their own supplies.

titulo.en: We walk it through with you

texto.es: Revisamos que todo quede impecable antes de irnos, en cada visita.
texto.en: We check that everything is spotless before we leave, on every visit.

nota.es: Cada limpieza se cotiza según el tamaño de la casa y la frecuencia; llámanos para una cotización gratis.
nota.en: Every cleaning is quoted based on home size and frequency; call us for a free estimate.

texto.es: Limpieza completa de principio a fin, cuarto por cuarto, con cocinas y baños totalmente detallados.
texto.en: A thorough, one-time clean from top to bottom, room by room, with kitchens and bathrooms fully detailed.

texto.es: Visitas regulares (semanales, quincenales o mensuales) para mantener la casa siempre limpia, con el mismo equipo cada vez.
texto.en: Regular visits (weekly, bi-weekly or monthly) to keep your home consistently clean, with the same team every time.

texto.es: Limpieza completa antes de mudarte o después de salir, incluyendo el interior de gabinetes y electrodomésticos.
texto.en: A full clean before you move in or after you move out, including inside cabinets and appliances.

texto.es: Detalle profundo de cocinas y baños: electrodomésticos, lechada, azulejo y accesorios.
texto.en: Deep detail of kitchens and bathrooms: appliances, grout, tile and fixtures.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llámanos igual, la mayoría de nuestros planes empiezan como una solicitud a medida.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Call us anyway, most of our cleaning plans start out as a custom request.

items.quote: Linda and her team do a fantastic job on my home. She was punctual, reasonably priced, brought her own supplies and did an amazing job on the house! The sliding glass windows were so clean I almost walked into it. I'd highly recommend her and plan on using her again.

Linda has been working with me for the past 2 years approximately, she cleans and cares for my home as if it was her own. Prices are absolutely reasonable for the great quality service her and her team do. Very efficient in what she does.

Wow! What a great company and cleaning service. Maria and team were very thorough and took great care in doing our deep cleaning. The first step in establishing them as our service and it was very successful and we are very happy with them.
